description: An agent-based simulation model designed to mimic user review and rating behaviors across multiple platforms, focusing on user preferences and platform-specific trends.

behaviors.name: write_review
behaviors.description: Users write reviews about products based on their preferences and past interactions.
behaviors.algorithm: Generate review text using LLM based on user preferences and product attributes.

behaviors.name: rate_product
behaviors.description: Users rate products based on their biases and product attributes.

parameters.rating_bias: Based on user's historical average stars.

behaviors.algorithm: Predict star rating using weighted sum of user bias and product average rating.

behaviors.name: receive_review
behaviors.description: Products receive reviews and update their average ratings accordingly.
behaviors.algorithm: Update average rating using a weighted moving average.

behaviors.name: update_rating
behaviors.description: Products update their ratings after receiving new reviews.
behaviors.algorithm: Recalculate average rating using a cumulative approach.

interactions.name: Reviewing
interactions.description: Users write reviews and rate products, affecting the product's average rating.
interactions.effect: Product's average rating is updated based on new review and rating.

algorithms.review_generation: Use LLM to generate review content based on user preferences and item attributes.
algorithms.rating_prediction: Predict star rating using a linear regression model based on historical data.

data_sources.name: amazon_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Training and validation of user behavior for Amazon platform

data_sources.name: goodreads_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Training and validation of user behavior for Goodreads platform

data_sources.purpose: Training and validation of user behavior for Yelp platform

data_sources.purpose: Initialization and profiling of user agents

data_sources.purpose: Initialization and profiling of product agents

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Main script to initialize and run the simulation.

files.description: Defines the User and Product agent classes and their behaviors.

files.name: interactions.py
files.description: Handles interactions between agents, such as reviewing and rating.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Defines the simulation environment and its parameters.

files.name: data_loader.py

1 - (Emotional Tone Error * 0.25 + Sentiment Attitude Error * 0.25 + Topic Relevance Error * 0.5)
